desc: Implement the prefix-sum moment solution in Python with stdin/stdout handling.
Precompute binomial coefficients C[n][k] for 0 <= k <= n <= K modulo 998244353.
Initialize prefix=0, S[0]=1, S[1..K]=0, and ans=0.
For each A_i, update prefix modulo 998244353, compute P^0..P^K with P^0=1, query the contribution using alternating signs, then update S[q] with P^q.
Run sample tests and verify outputs 75, 0, and 428633385.
If sample tests fail, switch to the DP ending-subarray moments approach.
